Consider the following statements regarding the Objectives Resolution moved by Jawaharlal Nehru:
(I) It laid down the fundamentals and philosophy of the constitutional structure
(II) It declared the firm and solemn resolve to proclaim India as an Independent Sovereign Republic
(III) It was moved on the same day the Constituent Assembly held its first meeting
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
faqs.e: The Objectives Resolution was moved on December 13, 1946, four days after the first meeting on December 9, 1946, making III incorrect.

faqs.q:
With reference to the Objectives Resolution, consider the following provisions:
(I) Adequate safeguards for minorities, backward and tribal areas
(II) Guarantee of justice, social, economic and political, to all people of India
(III) Equality of status of opportunity, and before the law
Which of the above is/are correctly identified as provisions contained in the Objectives Resolution?
On which date did representatives of princely states first join the Constituent Assembly?
faqs.e: Representatives of six states (Baroda, Bikaner, Jaipur, Patiala, Rewa and Udaipur) joined on this date. After the Mountbatten Plan of June 3, 1947 was accepted, representatives of most of the other princely states also took their seats.

faqs.q: The Indian Independence Act of 1947 made how many changes in the position of the Constituent Assembly?

Consider the following statements regarding the changes made by the Indian Independence Act of 1947 to the Constituent Assembly's position:
(I) The Assembly was made a fully sovereign body, empowered to abrogate or alter any law made by the British Parliament in relation to India
(II) The Assembly became a legislative body in addition to being a constituent body
(III) The Muslim League members from areas included in Pakistan joined the Assembly for the first time
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
faqs.e: The Muslim League members from areas included in Pakistan actually withdrew from the Constituent Assembly for India, not joined it, making III incorrect.

faqs.q: On which date did the Constituent Assembly first meet as the Dominion Legislature?
faqs.e: G.V. Mavalankar was elected as its speaker on this date. Whenever the Assembly met as the legislative body it was chaired by Mavalankar, while as the Constituent body it was chaired by Dr. Rajendra Prasad.

faqs.q: Till which date did the Constituent Assembly's dual functions of constitution-making and ordinary legislation continue?

Which province had the highest number of members in the Constituent Assembly as on December 31, 1947?
Which of the following was NOT among the six princely states whose representatives joined the Constituent Assembly on April 28, 1947?
faqs.e: The six states were Baroda, Bikaner, Jaipur, Patiala, Rewa and Udaipur.

faqs.q: On which date did the Constituent Assembly adopt the national flag?

Consider the following statements regarding functions performed by the Constituent Assembly, apart from making the Constitution:
(I) It ratified India's membership of the Commonwealth in May 1949
(II) It adopted the national anthem on January 24, 1950
(III) It adopted the national song on a date different from the national anthem
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
faqs.e: Both the national anthem and the national song were adopted on the same date, January 24, 1950, making III incorrect.

Which Constitutional Amendment Act inserted a new Article 394-A, providing for an authoritative Hindi text of the Constitution?
faqs.e: Enacted in 1987. Article 394-A was inserted in Part XXII, the last part of the Constitution.

faqs.q:
With reference to Article 394-A, which of the following statements is/are correct?
(I) The President shall cause the translation of the Constitution in Hindi to be published under his authority
(II) The Hindi translation of every amendment made in English must also be published
(III) The Hindi translation, once published, is deemed to be the sole authoritative text, superseding the English text
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
faqs.e: The Hindi translation is deemed authoritative for all purposes, but it is not stated to supersede the English text; both are to be construed as having the same meaning, making III incorrect.
